scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/client/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run fixtures && npx -y trek-plugin-sdk dev
scripts.status: npm run build && npx -y trek-plugin-sdk status
scripts.pack: npm run build && npx -y trek-plugin-sdk pack
scripts.publish: npm run build && npx trek-plugin-sdk publish --repo aangelisc/trek-timeline
